kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنبعث (form VII)
# أَنْبَعِثُ (ʔanbaʕiṯu) /ʔan.ba.ʕi.θu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
# أَنْبَعِثَ (ʔanbaʕiṯa) /ʔan.ba.ʕi.θa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
# أَنْبَعِثْ (ʔanbaʕiṯ) /ʔan.ba.ʕiθ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
